description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Brimaz's first ability triggers, creating an Incubator artifact token.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Clock of Omens by tapping Ancestral Statue and the Incubator token, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.
